mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAYP0015.retrieveAssignmentHistoryList */ to_char(ea.assignment_start_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') assignment_start_date , to_char(TO_date(ea.attribute1, 'yyyymmdd'),'dd/mm/yyyy') assignment_end_date , ea.assignment_type_1st AS assignment_type , ea.grade_type , ea.grade , ( SELECT cccm.common_code_name FROM lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm WHERE cccm.code_type_code = 'IF_VIETNAM_GRADE_TITLE' AND cccm.common_code = ea.grade_title AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} ) grade_title , ea.job_family , ea.job_group , ea.job_detail , ( SELECT cccm.common_code_name FROM lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm WHERE cccm.code_type_code = 'IF_POSITION' AND cccm.common_code = ea.position AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} ) position , ea.attribute10 AS shift_type FROM emp_assig ea WHERE ea.employee_number= #{employeeNo} ORDER BY ea.assignment_start_date
